nativeMaps.notes: Live run/walk map uses react-native-maps: Apple Maps on iOS, Google Maps on Android. Location permissions are configured via expo-location (when-in-use + always/when-in-use for live share). For production Android builds with Google Maps, set android.config.googleMaps.apiKey in app.json.

permissions.alwaysAndWhenInUse: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription — configured for live share prompt; app only requests foreground permission today
permissions.backgroundModesLocation: NOT enabled — UIBackgroundModes has audio only; GPS pauses when app is backgrounded unless background location is added

watchOptions.timeIntervalMs: 500 — Android only; iOS ignores timeInterval in expo-location watchPosition

iosGpsLiveTracking.preciseLocation: Test with Settings > Privacy > Location > Precise Location on/off; reduced accuracy increases horizontalAccuracy and may delay trail commits
iosGpsLiveTracking.deviceTesting: Required — iOS Simulator GPS is imprecise and speed is often null
iosGpsLiveTracking.webviewMap: Deprecated on iOS native — RunWalkActivityTrailMap uses react-native-maps; WebView fallback kept in .native.webview.tsx for reference only

permissions.foregroundService: FOREGROUND_SERVICE — configured (used by expo-audio background playback)
permissions.foregroundServiceLocation: NOT configured — add FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION + expo-location isAndroidForegroundServiceEnabled for background GPS
permissions.backgroundLocation: NOT configured — ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION not requested; live tracking is foreground-only today

watchOptions.timeIntervalNote: Validated in expo-location LocationHelpers.kt — sets FusedLocationProvider interval=500
watchOptions.mayShowUserSettingsDialogNote: Activity mode prompts user to enable high-accuracy device location when GPS/network provider is off

androidGpsLiveTracking.batteryOptimization: For QA: Settings > Apps > Telefarmed Cidades > Battery > Unrestricted (or disable optimization). Doze may throttle GPS when screen off.
androidGpsLiveTracking.systemGpsMode: Settings > Location > Location services > Google Location Accuracy ON; mode High accuracy recommended for QA

reactNativeMaps.provider: Google Maps via Play Services (default on Android)
reactNativeMaps.apiKey: NOT set — add android.config.googleMaps.apiKey before production release (EAS secret + app.config.js or app.json android.config)
reactNativeMaps.expoGo: Maps work in Expo Go; dev/prod builds need API key + SHA-1 in Google Cloud Console
reactNativeMaps.plugin: No Expo config plugin in react-native-maps@1.20.1 — use android.config.googleMaps.apiKey in app.json for prod Android builds

androidGpsLiveTracking.deviceTesting: Required — emulator GPS is usable but real device recommended for speed/fused location behavior

heading.safariIos: Test location prompt + compass after user gesture; fallback to GPS course heading
heading.fallback: enrichWithCourseHeading when speed >= 0.7 m/s and moved >= 3m

webGpsLiveTracking.limitations: Web GPS less precise than native — UX degrades gracefully; recommend native app for best live tracking
